project_type: Next.js 15.5.4 App Router PWA (React 19, TypeScript strict), fully client-side / offline, no backend
build_system: Next.js build wrapped by @serwist/next (next.config.ts). npm scripts only; no monorepo. Service worker is generated by Serwist on build (public/sw.js, gitignored) and DISABLED in `next dev`.
test_framework: Vitest 3.2.4 (environment: node). Tests live in src/lib/__tests__/*.test.ts. Includes a no-emoji scan that walks all of src for .ts/.tsx/.css/.mjs/.js files.
verification_instructions: After each change run `npm test` (155 tests incl. the no-emoji scan over src+css) and `npm run build` (Next build + Serwist SW generation). Both must stay green. Baseline is green: 155 tests pass; build succeeds with one PRE-EXISTING unrelated ESLint warning in src/lib/recommendation.ts (_exhaustive unused) which is not an error and must be left as-is. Service-worker/offline behavior is only observable via build+start, not dev; do not attempt runtime offline checks.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/sw.js and public/sw.js.map are generated by `npm run build` and are gitignored; do not hand-edit or commit them. No other generated/checked-in snapshots.
environment_constraints: macOS. Edit in place (NO worktree) under /private/var/www/html/heula. ZERO EMOJI anywhere in src or README, enforced by vitest; emoji in CSS comments also fails. Keep fully offline / no backend.
contribution_requirements: From README: tampilan mobile-first iOS style, Indonesian Gojek-casual voice; no emoji in any text; icons ONLY from react-icons/io5 via the single choke-point src/components/ui/Icon.tsx. Copy lives in src/lib/copy.ts (OFF-LIMITS) and must not be reworded.
key_patterns: Tailwind v4 CSS-first in src/app/globals.css: `@theme` block defines brand + semantic tokens; semantic color tokens (bg/surface/surface-2/border/content/content-muted) map to CSS variables swapped under :root (light) and .dark (dark). `@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *))`. `@utility safe-top/safe-bottom/safe-x` map to env(safe-area-inset-*). Radius tokens --radius-card (1.25rem) and --radius-pill (9999px); shadow tokens --shadow-card and --shadow-sheet. Components reference semantic utilities (bg-surface, text-content, text-content-muted, border-border, rounded-card, rounded-pill, shadow-card, shadow-sheet, bg-brand, text-brand, bg-brand-soft, text-brand-fg, bg-danger). cn() helper in src/lib/cn.ts merges classNames. motion/react is used for animation (spring transitions, layoutId highlights, whileTap not yet used). Theming: ThemeProvider toggles .dark on <html>; layout.tsx has an inline anti-flash script. The phone-width column is max-w-[480px], centered by AppShell.
